_about: Cables agent hand-back 2026-10-10: what the page agent needs to add cables-reef-wa to the 3D tab (per 04_build/UPDATE_PROTOCOL.md). Saved verbatim in substance by the orchestrator.
steps: (1) remove cables-reef-wa from 04_build/data/models3d_hold.json; (2) add entries to data/models3d_combined.json, models3d_curated.json, models3d_caveats.json; (3) run python src/update_page.py --full

combined.frame_note: model.js frame: x alongshore toward SOUTH (bearing 180), y offshore toward WEST (bearing 270); viewer maps (X = x, Y = z, Z = y); default outline version (design plan + extension)
combined.crest_note: design crest line RL -1.0 under datum reading A (RL = chart datum, MSL = RL + 0.78); under reading B it would be -1.0 m MSL
combined.shore_mode: the seabed window starts at y = 190 m and the shore line (y = 0) is not modelled, so the 'seabed near 0 m MSL along y = 0' check cannot apply; use whatever mode skips it

curated.state_short: Design state of the 1999 reef: V-shaped granite mound (Lyons 1992 design plan) with the drawn southern-arm extension, at design levels RL -1.0 (crest line) to -3.0 (outer edge). No survey of the built reef; default outline = design plan + extension, three more outlines offered.
curated.ve_note: At VE = 5 the 2 m ramp looks 10 m high; slopes of 1:13 to 1:20 look like 1:2.6 to 1:4 (plan is true).
key_numbers: Footprint: {{versions/design_plan_plus_extension_1999/area_m2|n0}} m2 default (design plan + extension), {{versions/design_plan_original_1999/area_m2|n0}} m2 original plan; text 140 x 70 m, traced 121 x 76 m
Rock volume: {{versions/design_plan_plus_extension_1999/volume_m3|n0}} m3 (fitted to Blacka's stated 5,500 m3; stated 3,500-5,500)
Crest: RL -1.0 = 1.78 m below MSL (reading A) or 1.0 m (reading B); ramp to RL -3.0 at the outer edge
Water depth: modelled bed 2.8-5.8 m at MSL vs stated 3.0-6.0 m
Tide: range 0.8 m (Blacka 2013); mean tide level 0.78 m above datum (Pattiaratchi 1999)

caveat_rows: RL datum not stated on the drawing (0.78 m; reading A/B switch)
bed under and around the reef is modelled, not measured
extension size from a low-resolution drawing
built extent / levels unverified (no imagery or survey)
shore line and nearshore profile not modelled
